mapper.sql: t.id AS id, t.media_id AS mediaId, t.generation AS generation, t.state AS state, t.preset AS preset, t.attempt AS attempt, t.execution_epoch AS executionEpoch, t.worker_id AS workerId, t.lease_until AS leaseUntil, t.next_run_at AS nextRunAt, t.progress AS progress, t.version AS version, t.error_code AS errorCode, t.trace_id AS traceId, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt

a.id AS id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.generation AS generation, a.attempt AS attempt, a.execution_epoch AS executionEpoch, a.worker_id AS workerId, a.state AS state, a.started_at AS startedAt, a.finished_at AS finishedAt, a.exit_code AS exitCode, a.error_code AS errorCode, a.error_summary AS errorSummary
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO processing_task (id, media_id, generation, state, preset, attempt, execution_epoch, next_run_at, progress, version, trace_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{mediaId}, 1, 'WAITING_EVENT', #{preset}, 0, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), 0, 1, #{traceId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM processing_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId}
SELECT FROM processing_task t WHERE t.media_id = #{mediaId}
SELECT FROM processing_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM processing_task t WHERE t.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND t.next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.attempt < 3 ORDER BY t.next_run_at ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE processing_task SET state = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, execution_epoch = execution_epoch + 1, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND state IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND attempt < 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_attempt (id, task_id, generation, attempt, execution_epoch, worker_id, state, started_at) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{taskId}, #{generation}, #{attempt}, #{executionEpoch}, #{workerId}, 'RUNNING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE processing_task SET state = 'SUCCEEDED', progress = 100, error_code = NULL, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND generation = #{generation} AND execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE media SET status = 'READY', output_key = #{outputKey}, poster_key = #{posterKey}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE media SET status = #{status},
output_key = NULL, poster_key = NULL,
version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE processing_task SET state = #{state}, error_code = #{errorCode}, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{retryDelayMillis} MICROSECOND), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND generation = #{generation} AND execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE processing_task SET state = 'QUEUED', version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND generation = #{generation} AND state = 'WAITING_EVENT'

UPDATE processing_task SET state = 'CANCELLED', error_code = #{errorCode}, execution_epoch = execution_epoch + 1, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND state IN ('WAITING_EVENT', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE processing_task SET generation = generation + 1, state = 'WAITING_EVENT', attempt = 0, progress = 0, error_code = NULL, execution_epoch = execution_epoch + 1, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND state IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT generation FROM processing_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_attempt SET state = #{state}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, exit_code = #{exitCode}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND finished_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_attempt a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.generation = #{generation} AND a.finished_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.attempt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_attempt WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
